text:
Joan: Heads-up: Deploybot is scheduled to start a staged rollout to v3.3.0 in eu-west during tonight's change window (22:00 UTC). Initial shift 5% then 15% at +10m. v3.2.1 is currently pinned for eu-west. I'm proposing we unpin during the 5% step if SLOs look ok. Opinions? @Luca @Ash
Luca: Agree with unpin at 5% if no regressions. We should watch kv-cache OOM alarms and tail latency.
Ash: Q: do we have a canary prompt set to run against embeddings? want to catch subtle quality regressions.
Joan: Yes, Ash — we added the "eu_canary_quality" eval. Pass threshold is 0.98 similarity score and embedding distribution variance within baseline.
Sam: If ops sees any 5xx spike > 0.5% or p99 latency up by 100ms, call pause. Ops oncall, can you confirm alert tuning?
ops-oncall: I'll be watching. Alerts set: eu-west 5xx rate (>0.5% for 2m), p99 token latency (+100ms for 5m). Ping me immediately.
Ash: Also suggest we don't unpin fully — instead change routing policy to "regional-fallback" while still keeping v3.2.1 as fallback for errors.
Luca: Makes sense. That way we can do auto-fallback for hot paths.
Joan: OK plan: deploybot will start 5% at 22:00. If alerts clear and eval passes at +10m, we convert routing to regional-fallback and unpin. If any trigger, hit rollback. Vote: +1 to go?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled rollout created by @Joan. Steps: 22:00 UTC 5% -> 22:10 UTC increase to 15%. Fallback: v3.2.1. To abort: `/deploy abort 3141592653` or click <link>. Status channel: #eng-releases.
Sam: :thumbsup: +1 from me. I'll sign off unless alerts fire.
ops-oncall: +1 from ops.
Ash: +1 if eval runs and no model drift.
Luca: +1. One ask: keep traffic shaping sticky to session-level for 30m.
Joan: Noted. Adding sticky flag. I'll unpin after 22:10 if everything green. Thanks all.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: 22:00 UTC -> rolling 5% started. Rollout id: 3141592653. Monitoring hooks: k8s metrics, kv-cache OOM, eval job. ETA next step: 22:10.
ops-oncall: Seeing no 5xx spike yet. p99 +20ms only.
Sam: Canary eval finished: similarity 0.991, variance within baseline. No redflags.
Ash: Nice. Proceed with unpin -> convert to regional-fallback.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Action: converted routing to regional-fallback and unpinned v3.2.1 for eu-west. Increasing traffic to 15% now.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: 15% shift completed. No automatic rollback triggered.
Joan: Great. I'll update release notes w/ canary results and close the change-window ticket.
